text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Someone's at the top of their game.Looking good, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I could say the same to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm looking forward to running<n>with you all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove's aura is as intimidating<n>as ever. And
Bright's presence is<n>practically equal to hers...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Then there's Suzuka. With her<n>fearsomely strong
legs and<n>otherwordly speed, no other racer can<n>hold
a candle to her.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (But I'm not racing against those<n>three today.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(First, I have to conquer myself. I<n>have to overcome
my weakness!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, you relish in races<n>against
powerful opponents, don't<n>you, Suzuka? The
stronger, the better,<n>correct?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This will be an exciting race for you,<n>then. I'm
certain you'll have an<n>exhilarating time today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's see how well you can do,<n>Dober!
